verify.prompt: Check this receipt, the way a parent or an auditor would.
verify.validText: In the CS Sainte-Marie ledger: ETOGA Y., 6e A, Instalment 1, 50 000 FCFA in cash, taken by A. Kamga on 15 Sept 2026 at 10:42. Compare with the paper: a different name or amount means the receipt was altered.

problem.title: A carbon receipt book proves nothing.

items.title: The fake receipt
items.text: A receipt can be copied, a stamp can be made. The day a parent shows a receipt the cash desk has no record of, nobody can settle it.

items.title: The cash gap
items.text: Between the cash desk and the evening deposit, a gap shows up at the end of the term, too late to know where it started.

items.title: “I already paid”
items.text: Without a shared history, every dispute means digging through the registers while a parent waits.

problem.turn: Payskool replaces the receipt book with a ledger where every correction stays visible, and gives every parent a receipt that can be checked.

school.title: At school: the cash desk, Mobile Money and fee collection in one place.

blocks.title: The cash desk takes a payment in seconds
blocks.text: The cashier finds the student, sees the instalments due and enters the amount. The receipt comes out with its number, the time, the cashier's name and the QR code. Every payment stays tied to whoever took it.

blocks.title: Online payments record themselves
blocks.text: When a parent pays from their space by MTN MoMo or Orange Money, the payment arrives with its reference: it is matched to the right student and the receipt is issued, with nothing to type at the cash desk.

blocks.title: See who is up to date, class by class
blocks.text: Collection rate, outstanding balance and late payers per class: today's picture, without waiting for the end of the term. Reminders go to the parents concerned, and only to them.

school.group: Several schools? Each keeps its own fees and cash desks, and you follow them all from one account.

money.title: The money goes to the school's account. Never to us.
money.text: Payskool is software, not a financial intermediary. Mobile Money payments land in your school's merchant account, opened with a payment aggregator such as CamPay or PayUnit. We record the payment and issue the receipt.
money.flowLabel: The parent pays the school directly; Payskool records the payment without ever receiving it.
money.payskoolSub: records the payment and issues the receipt

facts.title: No commission
facts.text: Payskool takes nothing from your collections. Only the operator's and the aggregator's own fees apply.

facts.title: Nothing to pay out
facts.text: Funds never go through us: there is never any money to recover from Payskool.

facts.title: Each school apart
facts.text: Your students' and cash desks' data is isolated from other schools.

parents.title: For parents: pay without travelling, and keep the proof.

points.title: Nothing to install
points.text: The parent space opens in the phone's browser. Sign-in with a code sent by SMS or WhatsApp, no password.

points.title: Every child in one place
points.text: Each child's balance, instalments and due dates on a single screen.

points.title: Pay an instalment remotely
points.text: By MTN MoMo or Orange Money, from home, without queueing at the cash desk.

points.title: The receipt arrives at once
points.text: On WhatsApp and in the history, with its QR code. No paper to keep.

pilot.title: The pilot programme
pilot.intro: Payskool is being finalised, and we are opening the pilot to a small group of private schools in Cameroon, from nursery to secondary. We start with the cash desk, receipts and instalment tracking; Mobile Money payments by parents are switched on afterwards, school by school. During the pilot Payskool is free; in return, you tell us what works and what is missing.
offer: Payskool for free for the whole pilot
Your student lists and fee schedules imported by our team
A direct WhatsApp line with the product team
pilot.after: After the pilot: a fixed monthly subscription, announced before the pilot ends, with no commission on your collections.

steps.title: You message us on WhatsApp
steps.text: School name, city, number of students. We call you back for a demo.

steps.title: We set up your school
steps.text: Classes, instalments and due dates, student lists imported from your Excel files.

steps.title: First receipts
steps.text: Your cashiers take payments on Payskool, and parents get their first verifiable receipts.

items.a: The product is being finalised and the pilot programme is open. We start with the cash desk, receipts and instalment tracking; Mobile Money payments by parents are switched on afterwards, school by school.

items.q: Does the money go through Payskool?
items.a: No. Mobile Money payments land in the school's merchant account with a payment aggregator (CamPay, PayUnit…). Payskool records the payment and issues the receipt; we never hold the funds.

items.q: Our parents mostly pay cash. Is Payskool still useful?
items.a: Yes, that is where we start. The cash desk records cash and cheques, issues the verifiable receipt and keeps track of each cashier. Mobile Money payments by parents come next.

Every receipt carries a unique number and a QR code. Scanning it finds that receipt in the school's ledger, with the student and the amount. An invented receipt is not there; an altered one does not match what the ledger shows.

items.q: Can a typing mistake be fixed?
items.a: Yes, with a cancellation that stays visible in the history. Nothing is erased: that is what protects your cashiers as much as your cash.

items.q: Do parents need to install an app?
items.a: No. The parent space opens in the phone's browser, with a code sent by SMS or WhatsApp.
Nothing during the pilot. After that, a fixed monthly subscription, announced before the pilot ends, with no commission on your collections.

items.q: Does Payskool handle grades and report cards?
items.a: No. Payskool only deals with money: fees, instalments, cash desks, receipts and collection. It runs alongside your school management software.

about.heroTitle: Building the financial future of education in Africa
about.heroSubtitle: Payskool was born from a profound conviction: the quality of education depends on the financial strength of the institutions that provide it. We give promoters absolute control over their cash flow.
about.manifestoP1: Running a school today is a constant challenge. Beyond educational excellence, promoters and founders face a complex reality on the ground: the archaic management of financial flows. Between the burden of handling cash, the risk of funds evaporating at the counter, and the tedious management of fake payment slips, leaders' energy is too often absorbed by administrative tasks instead of being invested in growth.
about.manifestoP2: Worse still, this financial opacity isolates institutions. Without a certified and unalterable revenue history, it becomes extremely difficult to prove solvency to banking partners. The result? Credit refusals or unsuitable financing conditions, which hinder or completely block expansion projects, the purchase of school buses, or the modernization of classrooms.
about.manifestoP3: It is against this backdrop that Payskool was created. We have brought together a team of experts in finance and educational management to build the benchmark platform dedicated to the African school ecosystem. More than just a collection solution, Payskool acts as the true trusted ally of promoters, transforming cash management into a powerful lever for peace of mind and development.
about.commitmentsTitle: Our commitments to the educational ecosystem
about.commitment1Desc: We put an end to the evaporation of funds. Every franc collected, whether at the counter or via Mobile Money, is timestamped, tracked, and recorded in an unalterable ledger. With Payskool, the tolerance for cash leakage is zero. Your financial data is encrypted and protected.
about.commitment2Desc: Designed 100% for the reality on the ground in Africa, our platform integrates natively with Mobile Money operators and local banking networks. We offer parents a smooth and frictionless payment experience, respecting their habits and guaranteeing transaction speed.
about.commitment3Desc: We give control back to leaders. With live visibility into cash flow and collections, promoters make informed decisions with total peace of mind. No more gray areas and nasty accounting surprises at the end of the month.
about.commitment4Desc: Our mission goes beyond securing payments. By certifying your regular revenue streams, Payskool provides you with a true passport to credit. We actively support you in financing your infrastructure by strengthening your credibility with lending institutions.
about.impact1Desc: The integrity of your revenue is guaranteed, every transaction is certified and unforgeable.
about.impact2Desc: The average collection level observed by our partner institutions in their first year.
about.impact3Desc: The volume of management, reconciliation, and paperwork hours saved by your administrative teams.
about.impact4Desc: Maximum availability of our platform to ensure continuous service.
about.ctaTitle: Let's build the school of tomorrow together.
about.ctaDesc: The independence and growth of your institution begin with serene and controlled financial management. Let's discuss your current challenges and discover how Payskool can secure and transform your daily life.

careers.heroTitle: Join the mission. Let's secure education in Africa.
careers.heroSubtitle: At Payskool, we don't just build collection software. We build the financial infrastructure that enables private schools to grow with peace of mind and shape the future of millions of students.
careers.cultureIntro: We are a team of builders. We combine the technical excellence of the world's top Fintechs with a deep and authentic understanding of African realities on the ground.
careers.culture1Desc: What you code, design, or sell today saves a school's cash flow tomorrow. At Payskool, your work doesn't get lost in a backlog: it has a tangible and immediate impact on the survival of educational institutions.
careers.culture2Desc: We manage the financial flows of education. Approximation is not an option; rigor is our foundation. We make no compromises on the security and reliability of our systems.
careers.culture3Desc: We master the complex reality of Mobile Money and cash payments in Africa, and we bring the most advanced software architectures on the market to it.
careers.culture4Desc: Like our product, our internal culture values clarity. Information flows freely, successes are celebrated as a team, and failures are our best learning opportunities.
careers.perksIntro: To solve complex problems, you need a free mind. We take care of our team so they can give their best.
careers.perk1Desc: Remote-friendly policy or hybrid work: choose the environment where you perform best.
careers.perk2Desc: Latest generation MacBook Pro provided from your first day, so your tools match your talent.
careers.perk3Desc: Top-tier premium health coverage for you and your family. Your peace of mind is our priority.
careers.perk4Desc: An annual budget allocated to your personal training (online courses, tech conferences, books of your choice).
careers.ctaDesc: We are always looking for brilliant, unconventional profiles deeply driven by the desire to make an impact. If you think you can bring unique value to Payskool's mission, don't be shy.

job.applyDesc: Send us your CV (or LinkedIn profile) and a short note about your motivations.

fullstack.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (NestJS / React)
fullstack.aboutText: We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to lead the development of our collection and financing platform. You will be responsible for designing robust architectures capable of securely processing millions of financial transactions.
fullstack.resp1: Design and develop new features in TypeScript (NestJS, React, Prisma).
fullstack.resp2: Ensure the security, performance, and reliability of the platform handling high transaction volumes.
fullstack.resp3: Mentor team engineers and spread technical best practices.
fullstack.req1: 5+ years of full-stack development experience (Node.js/NestJS, React, TypeScript).
fullstack.req2: Significant experience in designing financial (Fintech) or transactional applications.
fullstack.req3: Excellent mastery of PostgreSQL and complex data modeling.
fullstack.ben2: Premium equipment (MacBook Pro) and top-tier health insurance.

product-designer.title: Fintech UX/UI Product Designer
product-designer.aboutText: You will be the guardian of the user experience on Payskool. Your mission: transform complex financial flows into simple, reassuring, and extremely intuitive interfaces for school promoters and parents.
product-designer.resp1: Design user journeys from A to Z (Wireframes, Prototypes, High-Fidelity Mockups on Figma).
product-designer.resp2: Maintain and enrich our B2B Design System.
product-designer.resp3: Conduct user research and usability testing with our clients (school directors, cashiers).
product-designer.req1: 3+ years of Product Design (UX/UI) experience, ideally on SaaS B2B or Fintech products.
product-designer.req2: Ability to popularize complexity: you know how to turn a financial dashboard into a clear experience.
product-designer.req3: Excellent mastery of Figma and accessibility best practices.
product-designer.ben1: Major impact on a product used by dozens of schools.
product-designer.ben2: Total autonomy over design direction and a training budget.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p2: As part of using our collection and financing services, Payskool collects personal data (names, phone numbers for Mobile Money, financial information of institutions).
privacy.p4: We apply the strictest security standards (end-to-end encryption, isolated databases) to guarantee the absolute confidentiality of the financial data of our partner institutions and their students.
privacy.p6: In accordance with current regulations on the protection of personal data, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your data. Contact us at privacy@payskool.africa.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p2: These Terms govern the access and use of the Payskool SaaS platform by educational institutions (the 'Promoters') and their administrative teams.
terms.p4: The user agrees to use the platform in accordance with its intended purpose: the management and collection of school fees. Any attempt at fraud, data falsification, or misuse will result in immediate account suspension.
terms.p6: Payskool strives to maintain access to the service 24/7, with a target availability rate of 99.9%, subject to scheduled maintenance operations.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.p2: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when visiting a site or viewing an advertisement.
cookies.p4: We primarily use cookies strictly necessary for the operation of the platform (secure authentication of cashiers and promoters) and anonymous audience measurement cookies to improve our services.
cookies.p6: You can choose to disable these cookies at any time from your browser settings. However, this may impair access to some of our secure services.
